title: Use multimodal models for images · Level 3
slo: Explain how a multimodal model can use an image and text together.

exercises.question_text: What does a vision-enabled GPT model combine?

options.rationale: Vision-enabled GPT models interpret visual input. They respond in natural language.
Editing and remixing are media-generation activities. They do not define GPT with vision.
options.better_fit: Use this for image editing or video-remix capabilities.

options.rationale: Object detection is a narrow vision task. GPT with vision supports broader visual reasoning and language responses.
options.better_fit: Use this when only object identification is needed.

options.rationale: Text-only generation does not process visual input. Vision-enabled GPT combines visual understanding with language responses.
options.better_fit: Use this when no image or other visual input is involved.

exercises.explanation: Correct. GPT with vision combines visual understanding and language.

options.text: An Azure platform for enterprise AI work
options.rationale: Microsoft Foundry is an Azure platform for enterprise AI operations and application development. It includes a model catalog and broader development capabilities.

options.text: A screen for testing deployed models
options.rationale: This describes a playground rather than the full platform. A playground is one place for interactive testing.
options.better_fit: Use this for a question about testing a deployed model interactively.

options.rationale: An API is a code interface for sending requests. Foundry is the Azure platform that organizes enterprise AI work.
options.better_fit: Use this when code must send a model request.

options.rationale: An image-generation model is a specific AI capability. Foundry is the platform used to develop and operate AI applications.
options.better_fit: Use this when the task specifically requires creating or editing images.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Foundry is the broader Azure platform.

exercises.question_text: A multimodal model can use an image and text together to answer a question about a photo.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: One input would be left out.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Multimodal models combine more than one type of data.

exercises.explanation: Correct. It can combine the photo and written question.

exercises.question_text: Microsoft Foundry is only a playground for testing models.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: This narrows a platform to one testing activity.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Foundry supports enterprise AI operations and application development.

exercises.explanation: Correct. The playground is only one part of Foundry.

exercises.question_text: The GPT-4.1 family includes GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1-mini, and ___.

parts.text: The GPT-4.1 family includes GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1-mini, and

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The family would include a model from another family or purpose.

exercises.explanation: GPT-4.1-nano is the third listed member of the GPT-4.1 multimodal family.

feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Place the model, action, scope, and timing in that order.

exercises.correct_answer: A multimodal model can work with more than one data type at the same time
exercises.explanation: The sentence defines multimodal capability as working with more than one data type simultaneously.

exercises.question_text: Using text and image inputs together always requires separate vision pipelines.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The team could add unnecessary processing steps.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: A model that accepts text and images together can simplify an end-to-end workflow.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Combined-input models can reduce the need for separate pipelines.

exercises.question_text: What is an AI agent in this context?

options.text: A system that uses visual input for decisions
options.rationale: An AI agent can use visual input to make better decisions. It is an AI-driven system, not merely a model name.

options.text: A screen for testing a deployed model
options.rationale: A testing screen is a playground feature. An agent uses input to make or support decisions.
options.better_fit: Use this for interactive testing of a deployed model.

options.text: A model that creates new images
options.rationale: An image model creates visual output. An agent is defined here by decision-making with input.
options.better_fit: Use this when the goal is image creation or editing.

options.rationale: A classification label is an output, not an AI-driven system. An agent can use visual evidence to support actions or decisions.
options.better_fit: Use this when naming the result of a classification task.

exercises.explanation: Correct. An agent uses visual input to improve decisions.

exercises.question_text: Arrange the parts to form the correct statement.

feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Begin with the combined inputs, then state the resulting simplification.

exercises.correct_answer: Text and image inputs together can simplify end-to-end intelligent experiences
exercises.explanation: Combined text and image inputs can simplify complete intelligent experiences.

exercises.question_text: A radiology team must choose a Foundry option for reviewing X-ray images alongside clinicians' written questions. Which choices best fit this decision? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: GPT-4.1 can process images and text together. It meets the required input types.
GPT-4.1-mini is also a general-purpose multimodal model. It supports the required combined input processing.
Foundry includes partner models with text and image understanding. Such a model can fit the required capability.
Image generation creates or edits images. The decision requires understanding X-rays and answering written questions.
options.better_fit: Use this when the goal is to create or edit visual content.

feedback.intrinsic: The team could create an image rather than receive an interpretation.
feedback.instructional: Choose a multimodal model when image and text understanding are both required.

exercises.explanation: Correct. These choices support the required text-and-image understanding.

exercises.question_text: A support app can analyze ___ to help users.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The example would refer to a different workflow.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Use customer photos for the support-app example.

exercises.explanation: Support apps can analyze customer-submitted photos. Charts and screenshots represent other visual-input uses.

exercises.question_text: What can a vision-enabled GPT model do? Select all that apply.

options.text: Describe an image in natural language
options.rationale: It can interpret an image and describe it. Natural-language responses are a core capability.

options.text: Answer a question about a photo
options.rationale: It can use a photo with a written question. It then provides an informed language response.
Vision-enabled GPT supports flexible visual reasoning. It is not limited to one narrow image task.

options.error_type: Confuses vision reasoning with video generation
options.rationale: Video generation is a different capability. GPT with vision is defined by understanding visual input and replying in language.
options.better_fit: Use this for a video-generation request.
